deals.headline: Europa-Park Stadion financed through a city-owned stadium company: EUR 76.5m budget
deals.investor: Stadion Freiburg Objektträger GmbH & Co. KG (City of Freiburg), with SC Freiburg as atypical silent partner
deals.summary: The city-owned SFG built and owns the stadium on a total budget of EUR 76.5m: SC Freiburg's cash contribution of EUR 26.45m, a EUR 9.5m state infrastructure grant and about EUR 40m of capital-market loans (80% guaranteed by the city), repaid from the club's rent.

founded_evidence: Der SC Freiburg geht auf zwei im Jahr 1904 gegründete Vorgängervereine zurück.
name: Sport-Club Freiburg e.V.
notes: Founded year is the 1904 founding of the two predecessor clubs, as the club's own history gives it; the clubs merged as SC Freiburg on 3 March 1912. Revenue is for 2024/25 (year to 30 June 2025), the latest the club has published; 2025/26 figures are due at the October 2026 members' meeting. The same statement gives net profit of EUR 11.8m (Jahresüberschuss, after tax, so not recorded as pretax_result), equity of EUR 163.7m and a balance-sheet total of EUR 197.9m at 30 June 2025, and no bank liabilities. Wages are the DFL's published personnel expense for 2024/25 (single-entity accounts, EUR 83,116k); a revenue split is not published. No valuation: SC Freiburg is not in Forbes' 2026 list or Football Benchmark's European Elite 2026. Capacity: club and bundesliga.com both give 34,700 (the city's page says about 34,800). The supervisory board's members are listed on the club site but its chair is not named there. No owner percentage is stated: the e.V. is member-owned with no shares.
ownership_summary: SC Freiburg is a registered members' association (Sport-Club Freiburg e.V., Amtsgericht Freiburg VR 273) that runs its professional team itself, with no spun-off company and no outside investor; it is led by a two-person executive board (Oliver Leki, Jochen Saier) under a supervisory board. The club reports no bank liabilities.
revenue_evidence: Der Sport-Club setzte im abgelaufenen Geschäftsjahr (2024/25) 162,8 Millionen Euro um.
